svg.style: font-family:Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif;font-feature-settings:"liga", "kern", "calt", "lnum";text-rendering:geometricPrecision;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;font-size:18px;background-color:#fff

a.style: font-family:'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.style: font-size:25px;font-weight:600;font-family:'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif;line-height:1.2

text.tspan: The number of cases of a range of infectious diseases. Estimated cases are shown for paralytic polio, HIV/AIDS,
malaria and tuberculosis, while reported cases are shown for cholera, guinea worm, smallpox and yaws.
Data source: World Health Organization - Global Health Observatory (2026) and other sources
Note: Reported case numbers are limited by surveillance capacity.
